sec_10k.label: New annual report (10-K)
sec_10k.revisit_if: Any restatement, material weakness or auditor change; a stated Category II / regulatory-category change (H22); first disclosure of Union Bank stand-alone results or accretion (H14, Q1/Q9); a change in goodwill, allowance methodology or HTM/AFS classification (finding 3); a headcount figure that breaks the 2022-2025 trend (finding 5, 7).

sec_10q.label: New quarterly report (10-Q)
sec_10q.revisit_if: Return on tangible common equity, noninterest-bearing deposit share, CET1 or unrealized securities losses move by more than the tripwires in metrics_watch (see update); any new legal or regulatory matter in the notes.

sec_8k_2_02.label: Earnings release (8-K Item 2.02)
sec_8k_2_02.revisit_if: Same tripwires as the 10-Q; guidance that contradicts the forecasts in 5.2.

sec_8k_4_02.label: Non-reliance on prior financials (8-K Item 4.02)
sec_8k_4_02.revisit_if: ALWAYS. Finding 3 states there is no restatement or material weakness in any 10-K.

sec_8k_4_01.label: Change of auditor (8-K Item 4.01)
sec_8k_4_01.revisit_if: Always read the disagreement / reportable-event disclosure.

sec_8k_5_02.label: Director / officer change (8-K Item 5.02)
sec_8k_5_02.revisit_if: Departure of the CEO, CFO, chief risk or compliance officer, or any change in the Minneapolis-based leadership mix (finding 9).

sec_8k_1_01_2_01.label: Material agreement / acquisition or disposition (8-K Items 1.01, 2.01, 1.02)
sec_8k_1_01_2_01.revisit_if: Any announced acquisition, disposition or sale of a business line (corporate trust and payments are the distinctive fee businesses, finding 2).

sec_8k_2_05.label: Exit or restructuring costs (8-K Item 2.05)
sec_8k_2_05.revisit_if: Any announced job or branch reductions; check Minnesota WARN notices and branch counts.

sec_8k_other.label: Other 8-K
sec_8k_other.revisit_if: Read the item; usually no change.

sec_proxy.label: Proxy statement (DEF 14A / DEFA14A)
sec_proxy.revisit_if: Pay-ratio, incentive-metric or clawback changes; new 5% holders; new directors with Minnesota ties.

sec_other.label: Other SEC filing (Forms 3/4/5, 13F, S-3, 424B, 11-K, 25, etc.)
sec_other.revisit_if: Debt issuance and insider activity do not change conclusions unless unusual.

sec_peer.label: Peer annual / quarterly report
sec_peer.revisit_if: The peer medians used in findings 1, 2 and 10 are recomputed by the rebuild; compare the new gaps with the report values.

callreport_quarter.label: New Call Report quarter (bank-level)
callreport_quarter.revisit_if: Bank-level RoTCE gap to the peer median changes sign; noninterest-bearing deposit share changes by more than 2 points in a quarter; booked-office deposits (RC-O / SOD notes) shift by more than 10%.

y9c_quarter.label: New FR Y-9C quarter (holding company)
y9c_quarter.revisit_if: CET1 ranks last among the 11 peers again, or average assets cross a category threshold (Q: Category II).

enforcement_fed.label: Federal Reserve Board enforcement / order naming the bank (or a peer)
enforcement_fed.revisit_if: ALWAYS for an action naming the target. A peer-only action is context for 3.6 (peer comparison counts).

enforcement_occ_cfpb_fdic.label: OCC / CFPB / FDIC / DOJ / SEC action or settlement naming the bank
enforcement_occ_cfpb_fdic.revisit_if: ALWAYS. Finding 6 summarises the AML case and the 2022 incentive-pay order; a new order that cites staffing, caps or incentive pay would extend it.

federal_register.label: Federal Register document naming the bank
federal_register.revisit_if: Rule or notice that changes capital, deposit-insurance or consent-order status.

cfpb_complaints.label: CFPB complaint-database change
cfpb_complaints.revisit_if: Complaint count per quarter or share of untimely/relief responses moves materially versus the last snapshot.

warn_mn.label: WARN notice naming the bank (any state; Minnesota matters most)
warn_mn.revisit_if: A Minnesota notice naming the bank, or a multi-state pattern of notices (finding 9 says Minnesota branch cuts were smaller than elsewhere).

sod_year.label: New FDIC Summary of Deposits year
sod_year.revisit_if: The two booking offices' share of metro deposits (85.1% in the report), the share excluding very large offices (14.6%), or branch counts change by more than 2 points.

hmda_year.label: New HMDA data year
hmda_year.revisit_if: Metro origination share, denial-rate gaps or the $100 billion community-plan tracking (Q7) change.

cra_year.label: New CRA data / evaluation
cra_year.revisit_if: Manual download needed (FFIEC blocks automated access); once loaded compare small-business lending in the metro.

news_high.label: Significant news (headline match; secondary source, a lead only)
news_high.revisit_if: Verify against a primary source (filing, order, docket) before any figure is used. Headlines are not evidence.
